title: Software Engineering Intern, Summer 2025
eligibility: Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree program in Computer Science or a related technical field.
qualification: Pursuing a degree in CS, Software Engineering, or related technical field
description: Work on real-world projects alongside Google engineers, contributing to scalable applications and core software infrastructure during a 12-week summer program.

title: Gates Cambridge Scholarship 2025
eligibility: Citizens of any country outside the United Kingdom applying to pursue a full-time postgraduate degree at the University of Cambridge.
qualification: Bachelor's degree or equivalent with academic excellence
description: Provides full funding for outstanding international students to pursue a postgraduate degree in any subject available at the University of Cambridge.

title: Junior Frontend Developer (React)
eligibility: Open globally to candidates with strong fundamentals in JavaScript, TypeScript, and modern React development.
qualification: Bachelor's degree in CS or equivalent demonstrated open-source experience
description: Join Canonical's web team to design, build, and maintain front-end web interfaces across Ubuntu and Canonical websites and web services.

title: Associate Product Manager (APM)
eligibility: Recent graduates or early-career professionals with 0-2 years of experience in technical or product management roles.
qualification: Bachelor's or Master's degree in CS, Engineering, or Business
description: Rotational entry-level program designed to help young professionals learn product strategy, engineering partnership, and user experience design at Microsoft.

title: Microsoft Imagine Cup 2025
eligibility: Students aged 16+ currently enrolled in a high school, college, or university globally.
salary: Up to $100,000 USD + Azure Credits + Mentorship
description: A global student technology competition encouraging teams to solve real-world problems using Microsoft Azure AI and cloud technologies.

title: CS50x: Introduction to Computer Science
eligibility: Open to anyone worldwide with an internet connection; no prior programming experience required.
description: An entry-level computer science course introducing algorithmic thinking, data structures, security, software engineering, and web development in C, Python, SQL, and JavaScript.
